provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled material-physics study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

model: Use nondegenerate carriers n=Nc*exp((EF-Ec)/(kBT)),p=Nv*exp((Ev-EF)/(kBT)); singly ionized donors Nd_plus=Nd/(1+g*exp((EF-Ed)/(kBT))). Ed=Ec-binding. Charge neutrality is n=p+Nd_plus. No acceptors, band-gap narrowing or additional carrier reservoirs. The state densities are already evaluated at this temperature; do not rescale them again.
root_policy: Find the neutral solution with Ev<EF<Ec; charge residual n-p-Nd_plus is strictly increasing here. Quantities are conditional on these stipulated donor and Boltzmann models, not an experimental freeze-out calibration.
error_convention: Fully ionized shortcut predicts electron density Nd. Report abs(Nd/n-1), using the neutral model solution in the denominator.
